responsibility: Implements HP-UX host hooks for GCC’s precompiled-header support. It selects a plausible virtual-memory address region for PCH mapping, attempts direct file-backed mappings, and when fixed placement is unreliable falls back to anonymous mappings populated by explicit reads from the PCH file. This file belongs to GCC’s host abstraction layer for running on HP-UX, not to target ABI or code-generation configuration.
